proposed_renewal_B.decision_event: Every own remaining-hold expiry, including t0, independently for each UAV; no interruption or synchronized team barrier.
proposed_renewal_B.terminal_boundary: Allow selected d=4 near t255; execute only until the fixed horizon and record its actual duration as min(d,256-start). No post-terminal steps, bootstrap or carryover into the next reset.
proposed_renewal_B.native_counts_note: Existing diagnostics are T/G final t0..4 only (1600 rows); no complete renewal-event dump or added native observation is needed for the primary.

duration_work_bounds.head_row_law: 6 * training_owned_decisions + 2 * final_owned_decisions (sample + behavior density + four PPO epochs, then final sample + density)
duration_work_bounds.bounds_basis: All d=4 gives 64 renewals per UAV episode; all d=1 gives256. These deterministic work bounds are not a policy-class search or prediction of trained durations.
duration_work_bounds.T_velocity_samples: same as true own renewal count; fewer on held rows

proposed_renewal_B.objective: B04 native complete undiscounted return-to-go, gamma1, zero entropy coefficient, agent-compound PPO clipping; true action density only on renewal rows, primitive-row denominator retained.
proposed_renewal_B.primary: mean of 32 matched final episode J_T-J_G, J=sum primitive native team rewards/256; all T/G/H values and conditional evaluation SE retained; n=1 independent training pair.
proposed_renewal_B.headroom_record: absent; G and untuned H reused under matching task/action/information/training budget, no claim of tuned competence.
proposed_renewal_B.per_arm_cost_law: initialization + 131072 primitive environment/actor/recurrent steps + 1024 Adam updates +8192 final learned-arm evaluation steps + publication; G adds8192 H steps. T adds duration sampling/density/head-backward work at actual renewals; no extra environment or recurrent steps.

cost_reference.interpretation: Same native loop reference, not a measured renewal-policy forecast; head/categorical work grows materially and actual costs must be preserved within the same cap. No timing pilot or automatic cap growth.

proposed_renewal_B.added_validation: one focused affected-directory suite <=300s and independent ownership/mask/terminal/full-native-primary review; no standalone smoke, model replay, profiling or cost experiment.
proposed_renewal_B.execution_if_selected: same CM complete bounded technical batch; portable remote-first CPU FP32 one Torch thread, exact committed source and fresh physical/effective memory admission; accepted handle has one observer and is reported to Root.
proposed_renewal_B.all_outcome_stop: one selected pair ends at intake, no automatic second pair/retry/extra H/evaluation/tuning or successor.
proposed_renewal_B.censoring_reporting: Aggregate selected d=4 choices, censored holds and actually suppressed primitive decisions in existing counts/summary; no complete renewal event dump.

no_successor_option.reading: retain no ready successor from the tested opening evidence; do not infer broad impossibility or local lifecycle/family closure.
